summary: Added derived Idempotency-Keys (pl-<op>-<sha256[:24]>) on transfers, refunds and holds only, and up to 4 attempts with 1/2/4 s or Retry-After waits via transport.sleep, retrying on ConnectionError, 429, 500/502/503/504 and 409 idempotency_in_progress. Reversals send no key and re-read the transfer after a lost response or 5xx before resending; unit tests added and passing.
